rationale: Set CMP0057 explicitly in core/view/cmake/PulpViewJsEngines.cmake so its PULP_JS_ENGINE validation emits its own diagnostic when the module is loaded through `cmake -P`, where no project has established policies and IN_LIST would otherwise parse as a plain argument on CMake 3.x. Backend selection semantics, the set of accepted engines, and every rendering or asset path are unchanged; in a normal project configure the policy is already established and an invalid engine produces the identical FATAL_ERROR with or without this change.
tests: cmake-js-engine-selection negative-contract probes emit their intended diagnostics under cmake -P
